name: FFS_VISIT
description: Contains visits automatically created by the system.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: VISIT_DATE
columns.description: Date the visit record belongs to.

columns.name: VISIT_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the visit determined based on activities it consists of (pending, started, cancelled, notdone, completed).

columns.name: VISIT_MASTER_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the first activity in the visit.

columns.name: VISIT_OPTIONS
columns.description: Bitmask. Set of flags related to messages generated for the visit.

columns.name: VISIT_RESOURCE_TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Time zone automatically determined based on the master activity.

columns.name: VISIT_CONFIRMED
columns.description: Defines if the visit was confirmed by customer.

columns.name: VISIT_TIME_DELIVERED_START
columns.description: Start of the time window delivered to customer.

columns.name: VISIT_TIME_DELIVERED_END
columns.description: End of the time window delivered to customer.

columns.name: VISIT_KEY
columns.description: Visit key calculated based on configured formula.

columns.name: UPDATE_FLAGS
columns.description: Visit update trigger flags. Set automatically after Visit creation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
